intro: The past passive participle presents something as the object of an action already carried out: написанное письмо, открытая выставка.

bloques.titulo: The past passive participle presents something as the object of an action already carried out: написанное письмо, открытая выставка.
texto: The past passive participle presents something as the object of an action already carried out: написанное письмо, открытая выставка.
The form is in line with the noun; the agent may appear in instrumental if he / she is interested in identifying it.

frases.es: El documento firmado por el director ya se envió.
frases.en: The document signed by the director has already been sent.

frases.ru: В музее открыта выставка, подготовленная студентами.
frases.es: En el museo está abierta una exposición preparada por los estudiantes.
frases.en: An exhibition prepared by the students is open at the museum.

bloques.pregunta: What form is consistent with письмо?

opciones.explicacion: Письмо is neutral and requests написанное.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.

opciones.texto: The document signed by the director has already been sent.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: An exhibition prepared by the students is open at the museum.
opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.

bloques.frase: В музее открыта выставка, подготовленная студентами
bloques.traduccion: An exhibition prepared by the students is open at the museum.
bloques.explicacion: Look at the order of words and the outstanding grammatical form.
